title: Primitive Input, Timing, State & Goal Contract
objective: Define reusable primitive contracts for semantic input, deterministic logical timing, ephemeral local session state, counters/timers/targets/progress, success/failure, pause/retry, deterministic receipts and accessibility-equivalent controls without implementing traversal recipes, conflict patterns, NPC state machines, Aniloops or owner-domain rewards.

frozen_rules: Inputs are semantic and device-neutral; accessibility-equivalent mappings normalize to the same governed intent.
Timing truth uses deterministic logical integer ticks/durations/windows and excludes wall-clock, frame-rate, latency and raw device identity.
MAL session state and goals are ephemeral/local only and never create parallel Combat, Inventory, Project, Travel or progression truth.
Pause freezes MAL logical advancement without advancing campaign/world time; retry creates a new deterministic attempt identity without erasing canonical history.
Reference-collection observes authorized canonical references but does not create Inventory ownership or pickup truth.
MAL-local succeeded/failed/cancelled results do not commit owner-domain outcomes; later authorized integration must map MAL result references into owner domains.
Deterministic receipts exclude unauthorized hidden data, presentation prose, wall-clock values and raw device identity.
AI remains proposal-only and cannot commit outcomes, mutate owner truth or bypass visibility/accessibility rules.
